There is no Redis configuration. The cache layer uses an in-memory store. User entries expire after 10 minutes. This TTL matches the default for all caches.

r01.
There is no Redis connection. The cache is an in-process in-memory `cache.Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go`) created in `store.New` (`store/store.go`). User entries use the shared default TTL of **10 minutes** (`userCache.Set` → `DefaultTTL`); there is no user-specific Redis or per-user TTL override.
